thesis: No NVDA-specific catalyst today — it's a macro/rates day (claims, 30-year auction) with the tape de-risking into tomorrow's payrolls, so expect range-bound chop around 206-207 with drift driven by Nasdaq beta rather than anything about Nvidia.
day_plan: Treat this as a range day: no NVDA catalyst, so trade the levels and the clock, not a narrative. Let the 08:30 claims and the first 30 minutes define the range, then be a buyer of dips toward 204-206 while VWAP holds and a fader of failed pokes above 210; the 13:00 30-year auction is the one scheduled event that can break the range, so size down into it. Expect afternoon de-risking into tomorrow's payrolls to cap upside extension and shrink late-day volatility.
important_news: AMD fell 7-9% Tue/Wed despite data-center revenue doubling to $6.7B — the punish-on-margin-guidance reaction is the key read-through for how the market will treat NVDA's own Aug 26 print, and near-term it removes a share-loss narrative from NVDA
Sell-side/media build-up to NVDA Aug 26 earnings (calls for ~$95B rev vs $91B guide) — supports a bid into the print but is opinion, not news; no numbers change today
Ark Invest added to NVDA on Wednesday — flow-positive optics only, immaterial size relative to $5.3T cap
Insider-selling story ($3.4B across NVDA/PLTR/GOOGL/META trailing 12m) — recurring bear talking point, has not moved the tape
CXMT's ~500% IPO debut and $10B DRAM capex raise — matters only as an HBM/memory-supply cost narrative, watch if it bleeds into AI-hardware sentiment
Everything else in the feed (QQQ listicles, ETF comparisons, millionaire-maker takes) is noise — ignore

schedule.event: Overnight semis/AI tape: check SOX futures, TSM/ASML ADRs, and any Asia memory follow-through from the CXMT IPO
schedule.why_it_matters: NVDA's open is almost entirely group beta today; a red semi complex caps any gap-up attempt

schedule.event: Initial jobless claims + Q2 nonfarm productivity & unit labor costs
schedule.why_it_matters: Claims is the only labor read before tomorrow's NFP; a hot claims number moves rate expectations and long-duration megacap tech in the pre-market
First 15 minutes sets the day's range; with no stock-specific news the opening drive usually retraces rather than trends
On catalyst-free days NVDA typically establishes its VWAP band here; the 10:30 area is where the real range for the session gets defined

schedule.event: Treasury 30-year bond auction (final leg of quarterly refunding)
schedule.why_it_matters: A sloppy tail steepens the curve and is the single most likely intraday source of a megacap-tech air pocket; a strong auction usually gives equities a 1-2pm lift
Highest chance of a false breakout on thin liquidity — the classic chop-and-trap window
Traders flatten ahead of 08:30 Friday NFP; expect fade of intraday extremes and MOC-driven final print

schedule.event: No NVDA event; watch for supply-chain or AI-capex headlines only
schedule.why_it_matters: Earnings is Aug 26 — there is no post-close catalyst in this name today

key_levels: 206.69 — prior close and the day's pivot; holding above it on any morning dip keeps the into-earnings drift intact
210 — round-number/near-all-time-high magnet; a push through with volume signals the pre-Aug-26 melt-up is live, failure there is the obvious short-side fade
203-204 — first real support zone / likely prior-day low area; loss of it on a soft auction or hot claims opens 200
200 — psychological round number and where a real pre-payrolls de-risk would take it; a break would mark the first genuine trend change in the name
Session VWAP — with no news, the honest bias tool: above and holding = buy dips, repeated rejections = mean-revert short
SOX / QQQ relative strength — NVDA underperforming the group on a green tape is the earliest sign of distribution near highs
invalidators: NVDA gaps or trades below 200 — the into-earnings-drift read is dead and this becomes a momentum-break day
Decisive break and hold above 211 on above-average volume — upside melt-up, stop fading strength
Jobless claims materially above ~250k or unit labor costs sharply hot at 08:30, driving a >1% Nasdaq futures move — macro takes over and the range thesis is void
30-year auction tails badly (yield well above when-issued, weak indirect bids) and 30y yield jumps >6bp — expect a genuine afternoon leg lower in megacap tech
Any NVDA-specific headline: China export-license change, hyperscaler capex cut, a pre-announcement, or a major customer switching silicon — bias becomes irrelevant
NVDA underperforming SOX by more than ~1.5% intraday — signals name-specific distribution near highs rather than macro chop
